scope: isolated actual-source probes, synthetic records, no network or database
meaning: reproduced=true confirms the audit condition exists; it does not mean the application is secure

results.name: Email OTP for a new email can authenticate a legacy phone-only account without phone OTP
Public signup authenticates an incomplete account without OTP even when phone OTP is disabled
Random-IV encrypted phone cannot match the equality lookup parameters
A token revoked by auth token_version checks is still accepted by the product API guard
Public guest-login can mint a JWT accepted by private product API guards
Production OTP verification logging includes the supplied OTP
Concurrent verification can consume the same email OTP successfully twice
Enabling database access logging breaks queries through the db/logger circular dependency
